note: Synthetic documents with fabricated codes. Bank 999 does not exist; no real bill data.

boleto.pdf.purpose: Valid boleto line (due 2026-07-07, R$ 123,45) and a Pix payload wrapped across two lines, over two pages.

locked.pdf.purpose: boleto.pdf locked with the password 1234 (40-bit RC4); must read only with that password, otherwise report locked.

permissions-only.pdf.purpose: boleto.pdf with only a permissions password; must open without a password, even when a wrong one is also given.

no-codes.pdf.purpose: Readable text with no payment code; must report no-codes, not an empty success.

bad-check-digit.pdf.purpose: Boleto line with its general check digit altered; must be reported invalid.
